subject: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Evan Walker <evan.walker@spectra-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Thanks for the call today, Evan — good to meet and learn more about Spectra's roadmap. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Use case: customer support automation + fraud detection enrichment (short prompts, frequent calls).
- Expected ramp: POC starts Aug, production in Q4.
- Estimated token profile: 30-70 tokens per request (averaged), with spikes for enrichment flows.
- Volume guidance: you mentioned rough monthly volumes, can you confirm a starting band? (helps lock unit economics)
- Procurement: you flagged an approval threshold and PO process — thanks for sharing details in follow-up.

Attached: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (very high-level, illustrative) — this assumes a baseline unit price and shows three commit tiers.

Ask: Could you confirm the monthly spend band you'd be comfortable committing to for a Q4 rollout (e.g., <$10k/mo, $10k-$50k/mo, $50k-$200k/mo, >$200k/mo) and any procurement thresholds we should hit to keep the contract simple? Also, what target $/1M tokens feels reasonable for Spectra (ballpark is fine — we can tailor tiers/commits).

Next steps: once you confirm band and procurement constraints, I can draft a tiered offer that lines up with your PO/approval timelines. Happy to jump back on a 20-min call with procurement if that helps.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D +1 (415) 555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com
redwood.com

From: Evan Walker <evan.walker@spectra-systems.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@spectra-systems.com
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Thanks Dylan — great overview. Quick answers inline: 

On Mon, Jul 27, 2026 at 3:12 PM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Estimated token profile: 30-70 tokens per request (averaged), with spikes for enrichment flows.
> - Volume guidance: you mentioned rough monthly volumes, can you confirm a starting band?

We expect the POC to run in Aug/Sep at ~50M tokens/month. If the POC proves out (likely), target production ramp in Q4 to ~150-200M tokens/month. That range covers our likely needs for the first 12 months.

Procurement notes: our procurement team requires formal vendor approval for anything above $50k/month (they escalate to our legal and vendor risk). Below $50k/mo we can do a standard SOW + PO internally. For anything >$50k/mo we need a signed contract and insurance evidence.

Target unit economics: open to discussing, but our benchmark target for budget planning is around $1,200 per 1M tokens (ballpark). If you can show a tier where committed volume (e.g., 150M+/mo) reaches $900-1,000/1M, that would make the economics work.

I've cc'd procurement with this note so they see the thresholds.

Evan
Evan Walker
Head of Platform, Spectra Systems
evan.walker@spectra-systems.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

FYI — Evan confirmed volumes: POC ~50M/mo, production ramp to 150-200M/mo. Procurement threshold at $50k/mo (anything above requires contract/legal). Target unit economics: ~ $1,200/1M tokens budget target; they'd be interested if we can get to $900-1,000/1M at 150M+ commits.

Attachment: I included the pricing estimate I sent them.

Asks: 
- Can we be flexible on a tiered discount structure (committed volume tiers) to hit the ~$900-1,000/1M at the 150M+ level?
- Approve a PoC-friendly offer (short commit, higher unit) for the 50M POC to avoid procurement overhead initially? We could structure the POC as a time-limited pilot under our standard T&C and push the contract once they cross $50k/mo.

If you want, I can draft two SKUs: Pilot (50M/mo, month-to-month) and Production Commit (3-12 month tiers with discounts). I'll loop legal once we land the numbers.

Thanks,
Dylan

> On Mon, Jul 27, 2026 at 5:05 PM Evan Walker <evan.walker@spectra-systems.com> wrote:
> > We expect the POC to run in Aug/Sep at ~50M tokens/month...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Thanks for the heads-up. Proposal: we offer a two-phase commercial approach:

1) Pilot: 50M tokens/mo, month-to-month, higher unit price ($1,350/1M) to keep procurement simple — no long-term commit, start immediately.
2) Production Commit: tiered discounts for 3/6/12 month commits. Aim for ~ $1,050/1M at 150M/mo on a 6-12 month commit, with a placeholder for $900/1M at 200M+ if they sign a 12-month firm commit.

This keeps procurement happy (pilot under $50k/mo), gives them a path to the economics they want, and allows us to protect margin. Draft the two SKUs and include the legal & insurance checklist for >$50k. Loop legal once Evan confirms interest on the commit tier.

Also: include a short summary table for procurement that shows monthly spend bands and the approval path (PO vs contract).

Go ahead and draft — I'll review before we send.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
